entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Edgar E. Witt was an American lawyer and politician who served as the 29th lieutenant governor of Texas from 1931 to 1935. He also served twice as chairman of the American-Mexican Claims Commission and chief commissioner of the Indian Claims Commission.
